title: Redact a stream as it passes
summary: The starter redacts API keys in a child's output, piece by piece, on its way to the plugin that started the child. Pieces are cut where the child happened to write, not at line ends, so a key written in two parts passes, half in each. Redact whole lines, pass each on as soon as it is complete, and leave the rest as it came.

steps.title: A key split across two pieces is redacted
Each line passes on as soon as it is whole
